facts.name: Andrea K. Totten
facts.assignment: Division61 county civil and small claims; profile additionally identifies protective-services, mental-health/substance-use, tuberculosis, firearm-disability and risk-protection matters. Practices document labels Division61 County Civil, Small Claims and Circuit Civil; no general circuit-civil jurisdiction inferred.

office_address: Kim C. Hammond Justice Center, Courtroom402
contact.contact_note: Profile expressly lists no fax. Shared office/assistant telephone; personal judicial email not established.

hearing_scheduling.summary: File motion first and coordinate parties. Use Flagler Benchmark for non-emergency hearings under one hour; scheduling guide also describes four15-minute blocks and directs longer requests to assistant. File notice within24hours and email assistant; contact assistant for cancellations or mistaken reservations.

conferral.summary: Include opposing position in motion; coordinate hearing. Unilateral scheduling only after three unsuccessful attempts on different days at least one day apart, documented in notice.

proposed_orders.summary: File separately through e-portal File Documents on Existing Case to Clerk, unless directed otherwise; do not attach order to motion. Mailing/emailing chambers is not filing. Cover letter optional and separately filed.

courtesy_copies.summary: E-file memoranda/authorities at least two business days before hearing, allowing clerk docketing time; emailed courtesy copies optional and appreciated.

remote_appearances.summary: In-person default. Each participant must separately obtain motion/order permission. File remote request after hearing notice and at least two business days before hearing; notice continues to identify in-person location even if individual permission granted.

chambers_communications.summary: Email assistant with case number and party names; copy all parties except legally authorized ex parte communications.

facts.summary: Benchmark scheduling, existing-case e-portal submissions, optional emailed courtesy copies and participant-specific remote permission. Practical civil operating review only.

review_scope.collected: Profile and four PDFs: practices6pages, scheduling3pages, remote3pages, orders2pages.
review_scope.content_reviewed: Practices pages1–3 recurring operations; scheduling basic reservation/notice/cancellation; remote page1 authorization; order-filing channel/format sections. Profile assignment/contact.
review_scope.not_reviewed: Specialized noncivil substance, motion-type strategies, detailed trial/exhibit procedures or linked pretrial/waiver forms; remaining collected text not asserted fully reviewed.

conflicts.statement: Profile lists specific county civil/small-claims and protective proceedings; July2025 practices title adds Circuit Civil. Preserve both without inferring general circuit assignment.

Scheduling page1 requires electronic reservations for less than one hour; page3 permits up to four15-minute blocks and refers more than one hour to assistant. Exact one-hour wording differs; no resolution.

Totten orders PDF says county lacks direct proposed-order option and directs existing-case filing; Distler August2026 practices require proposed-order option. Preserve division-specific instructions without selecting countywide rule.

gaps: Fax explicitly not listed; personal judicial email and separate assistant-only phone not established.
